reviews.text: One of my favourite products from Bioheal - it works very well with their serum combination and provides an uplift to my face when used. It’s not extremely creamy so this can be used anytime throughout the day, with fast absorption, allowing layering with other products
reviews.zh: Bioheal 嘅其中一款心頭好——配合佢哋嘅精華組合用，效果好好，用咗之後令面部有提升感。佢唔係好厚身，所以全日任何時間都可以用，吸收快，方便同其他產品疊搽。

reviews.text: I have oily skin, so I prefer using this face cream at night on clean skin. It’s a more active and rich cream, which is why I don’t use it in the morning for my skin type it can feel a bit too heavy during the day. Overnight, though, it works really well and leaves my skin feeling nourished and refreshed by morning.
reviews.zh: 我皮膚係油性，所以我比較鍾意晚上喺潔淨嘅皮膚上用呢款面霜。佢係一款比較活性、比較豐厚嘅乳霜，所以以我嘅膚質嚟講，我唔會朝早用，因為白天會覺得有少少太厚重。不過晚上用就好好，第朝醒嚟皮膚會感覺滋潤、清爽。

reviews.text: This is one of my favourite cream forever, nice and glowing skin you receive. The smell is good, what it makes to skin is some kind of magic. It called remodelling, and it really remodel you skin and upgrade it to the whole new level. This is already my 5th repurchase of this cream, I have combo skin, but it also very good for summer night routine.
reviews.zh: 呢款係我永遠嘅心頭好之一，用完皮膚會有好靚嘅光澤。味道好好，佢對皮膚嘅效果好似有啲魔法咁。佢叫 remodelling（重塑），真係可以重塑你嘅皮膚，將皮膚提升到一個全新嘅層次。呢個已經係我第五次回購呢款乳霜，我係混合性皮膚，但係夏天晚上護膚都好好。

reviews.text: Used the entire jar and it was a very nice cream for my middle-aged, flush-prone, clog-prone skin. Gel-like in texture, it absorbs easily and doesn't pill when sunscreen is applied over the top. VERY slight pore tightening effect. Will probably buy again.
reviews.zh: 我已經用晒成罐。對於我呢種中年、容易泛紅、容易阻塞毛孔嘅皮膚嚟講，呢款乳霜好好。質地似啫喱，好易吸收，塗防曬喺上面都冇搓泥。毛孔收細效果非常輕微。我大概會再買。

reviews.text: Totally obsessed with bioheal. Since I’ve been using it my skin looks amazing- pores have shrunk, overall complexion is lighter and clearer. I’ve had many compliments and have gotten several friends on to it too with everyone just as happy with the results. Love the scent and texture too
reviews.zh: 我對 bioheal 完全痴迷。自從用咗之後，皮膚睇落好靚——毛孔收細咗，整體膚色變得更亮、更清透。我收到好多讚美，仲推薦咗幾個朋友去用，大家對效果都好滿意。我都好鍾意味道同質地。

reviews.text: This cream is so nourishing and makes my skin feel firm, smooth, and refreshed. The texture is rich but absorbs well without feeling heavy, and I’ve noticed my skin looking more plump and hydrated. It really gives that healthy, youthful glow. Definitely a product I’d recommend and buy again!
reviews.zh: 呢款乳霜好滋養，令皮膚感覺緊緻、滑溜、清新。質地豐厚，但係吸收得好，唔會覺得厚重，我發現皮膚睇落更加飽滿、水潤。佢真係帶嚟一種健康、年輕嘅光澤。絕對係我會推薦同再買嘅產品！

reviews.text: I purchased this because I bought their 3D Lifting Cream and thought it was just alright, so instead of repurchasing I was curious to try this Collagen Remodeling Cream next. It’s definitely a lighter texture and pairs well with the Collagen Remodeling Serum (which I LOVE and am so happy this box came with a mini travel version of it).
reviews.zh: 我買呢款係因為之前買咗佢哋嘅 3D Lifting Cream，覺得只係一般般，所以唔想回購，反而好想試吓呢款 Collagen Remodeling Cream。質地肯定比較清爽，同 Collagen Remodeling Serum 配搭得好好（我好鍾意嗰支精華，好開心呢盒入面附咗一支迷你旅行裝）。

reviews.text: 1 dont like that they put perfume in it
reviews.zh: 我唔鍾意佢哋喺入面加咗香水。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
